```{r}
stem_clusters <- c("7", "8")
srt_sub <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, 
                  sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5 %in% stem_clusters & Phase == "G1")
gene_detection <- Matrix::rowSums(GetAssayData(srt_sub, "RNA", layer = "counts")>=1)
srt_sub <- srt_sub[gene_detection>=10,]
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)

```


```{r}
srt_sub <- srt_sub %>% 
  SCTransform(assay = "RNA",) %>% 
  RunPCA(assay = "SCT") %>%
   FindNeighbors(dims = 1:10) %>%
   FindClusters(resolution = c(0.5,0.9)) %>%
   RunUMAP(dims = 1:10,
           min.dist = 0.05, 
           n.neighbors = 15)

```

```{r}
srt_sub <- srt_sub %>% 
  SCTransform(assay = "RNA",
              vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"),
              residual.features = setdiff(srt_sub, unlist(proc_params$exclude_reporters))) %>% 
  RunPCA(assay = "SCT") %>%
   FindNeighbors(dims = 1:10) %>%
   FindClusters(resolution = c(0.5,0.9)) %>%
   RunUMAP(dims = 1:10,
           min.dist = 0.05, 
           n.neighbors = 15)

```

Binarize the data matrix

```{r}

stem_clusters <- c("7", "8")
srt_sub <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, 
                  sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5 %in% stem_clusters & Phase == "G1")
gene_detection <- Matrix::rowSums(GetAssayData(srt_sub, "RNA", layer = "counts")>=1)
rna_counts <- GetAssayData(srt_sub, "RNA", layer = "counts")[gene_detection>=10,]
rna_counts[rna_counts>=1] <- 1
srt_sub[["bin_RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(data = rna_counts)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)
srt_sub <- srt_sub %>%
  ScaleData(assay = "bin_RNA") %>% 
  FindVariableFeatures(assay = "bin_RNA",selection.method = "disp") %>% 
  RunPCA(assay = "bin_RNA") %>%
   RunUMAP(dims = 1:10)
```
